newsitem.title: CHINA: China steel output up 6.7 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: China steel output up 6.7 pct in first half.

text.p: China produced 52.5 million tonnes of steel in the first half of the year, up by 6.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, the China Daily said on Wednesday.
Of that, production of rolled steel was 46.86 million tonnes, up by 9.4 percent from a year ago, it said quoting figures from the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry.
The industry reported a high sales to output rate, with the top 10 iron and steel plants reporting a rate of 99.91 percent, it said.
However, stockpiles still increased slightly, it said.

Domestic producers' market share increased in the first half: exports of rolled steel were 3.13 million tonnes, up by 20.8 percent from last year and imports were 5.42 million tonnes, a decrease of 15.04 percent from the year-ago period, it said.
